This is my temporary description of the website, which will contain r code relevant to the Data 200 class

Always run your libraries each time you start working on a document, whether its the first time you're opening it or if you're reopening it

```{r}
#| eval: false
#Example for if you're using the tidyverse and bayesrules packages
library(tidyverse)
library(bayesrules)
```

Remember, you can use the '?' code in R to get some information about a function

```{r}
#| eval: false
?ggplot #Example for getting help documentation about ggplot
```
